verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear brand-image-headline-CTA reading order with the logo intact, but the schedule is shattered into microscopic fragments scattered out of date order (20 Jan top, 02 Dec mid-right, 16 Dec at the bottom edge), the CTA crowds those rows, and the legal and 'Winter Programme' text are illegible. B is worse: the schedule fragments are scattered across the whole banner in even less order and jammed against the top and bottom edges, the CTA sits on the far left before the headline, the logo is shrunk to an illegible speck crammed beside the legal line, and 'studios' wraps on its own as an orphan.
